description: Connects to a domain on port 443 and reports its TLS certificate: whether it is trusted and matches the name, the issuer, the expiry date and days left, the lifetime, the chain and the TLS version, what each of its server addresses serves (up to 4 IPv4 and 4 IPv6), and, for certificates from Let’s Encrypt, Google Trust Services, ZeroSSL or Sectigo, the renewal window the CA suggests (ACME Renewal Information).

domain.description: A public domain name, like example.com. A URL also works: only its host name is used.

name: check_certificate
title: Check a TLS certificate
